decision.explanation: Documents d00 and d01 describe Araki Station in Chiba (Narita Line) with conflicting opening dates of April 1, 1958, and January 1, 1960 respectively, while documents d02, d03, and d04 describe a different Araki Station on the Kagoshima Main Line (Kurume/Fukuoka area) opened on April 20, 1910; since the query does not specify the location, all three distinct dates represent valid answers for different referents sharing the name.
